finalPrompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE production sprite atlas for Dream Town. Match existing cozy painterly isometric town art: creamy plaster, terracotta roofs, dark oak, jewel green foliage, soft sunlight from upper left, polished hand painted 3D illustration, crisp readable silhouettes. Exactly 4 columns by 2 rows, 8 sprites in strict row-major order. Equal sized cells, each subject centered, at least 15 percent empty padding on EVERY side inside every cell. No sprite crosses its cell. Row 1: welcoming zoo entrance with animal silhouette sign, no letters; grassy fenced animal habitat with shelter and pond; friendly zookeeper with bucket; basket of animal feed fruit and hay. Row 2: cute elephant; cute giraffe; cute zebra; friendly lion. All animals whole body, calm standing pose, 3/4 isometric, distinct isolated sprites. Genuinely transparent alpha background and gutters. No checkerboard, solid background, captions, typography, watermarks or grid lines. No extra sprites. Whole subjects, no clipping. Buildings on small individual isometric grass/stone foundations. Aim for 2048px wide high quality sheet. OVERRIDE SIZE: each object occupies ONLY central 55% of its own equal sized cell. Huge transparent padding, especially above giraffe horns and below habitat. All 4 columns must have EXACT same width; do not widen architecture cells. Make buildings smaller if necessary. This is an atlas to slice into exactly equal cells.
